tagline: Building Scalable Digital Products at the Intersection of Software, Data & AI.
description: Full-Stack Developer and Data Science postgraduate building scalable, data-driven products across software, analytics, and AI.

roles.detailed: Full-Stack Engineer · Gen AI · System Design

bio: I'm a Full-Stack Developer and Data Science postgraduate focused on building scalable, data-driven digital products. My experience spans web application development, backend systems, data analytics, and AI/GenAI solutions, with a strong interest in turning complex problems into practical products. I enjoy working across the stack, from designing reliable systems and APIs to extracting insights from data and building intelligent workflows.

bullets: Built full-stack features for a medicine-delivery and fleet product, covering orders, rider tasks, and delivery status.
Developed API-backed screens for attendance, collections, and field-team tracking used by pharma distributors.
Connected operational dashboards to live delivery data so the team could follow a shipment without manual updates.
Fixed interface issues and shipped small releases with the product team across the six-month internship.
experience.desc: Six-month full-stack internship on FastWhistle's medicine delivery and fleet software. Orders, rider tasks, attendance, collections, and delivery tracking.

bullets: Designed and delivered Amaba Jewellery, a brand website led by product photography, with collections that stay easy to browse on desktop and mobile.
Built eduCare, an education platform covering courses, learner progress, and educator follow-up from enrolment through each lesson.
Shipped a WhatsApp CRM for campaigns, message templates, and conversation follow-up, so client communication stays in one place.
Built Document Intelligence, a financial-document workflow that reads PDFs and spreadsheets, stores table data for lookup, and returns answers with citations.
Ran each engagement from the first brief through layout, build, and handover, with a working product the client could use.
Kept the interface consistent from wide screens to phones, and structured pages so content can change without breaking the layout.
Paired the interface with the API or data layer when the product needed accounts, messages, or document search.
experience.desc: Independent full-stack work across brand websites, an education platform, a messaging CRM, and a financial-document workflow. Each engagement runs from brief through build and handover.

projects.title: Knowledge Transfer
projects.subtitle: Institutional RAG System
projects.desc: Turns historical emails into a searchable knowledge base. The pipeline cleans and chunks messages, embeds them, stores vectors in FAISS and metadata in DuckDB, and answers with a Gemini RAG flow that cites the source messages.

projects.title: MediReminder India
projects.subtitle: AI Medicine Adherence Platform
projects.desc: Backend for a multilingual medicine-adherence platform. It analyzes prescriptions, flags food-drug interactions, helps with missed doses, and escalates to caregivers, with 90% successful end-to-end processing across 30 workflows.

projects.title: Sales Performance
projects.subtitle: Atliq Hardware Finance Analytics
projects.desc: Excel reports for Atliq Hardware covering yearly sales, market performance against targets, customer contribution, and profit-and-loss by year, market, and month.

projects.title: Customer Churn
projects.subtitle: Telecom Retention Model
projects.desc: Telecom churn analysis across contract, billing, and service usage. Classifiers were compared, and a voting model of gradient boosting, logistic regression, and AdaBoost reached about 84.7% accuracy.

publications.title: Amaba Jewellery
publications.desc: A client website for a jewellery brand. Product photography leads each page, collections stay easy to browse, and the layout holds together from desktop to mobile.

publications.title: eduCare
publications.desc: An education platform for courses, learner progress, and educator follow-up. The structure takes a student from enrolment through lessons without losing their place.

publications.title: Document Intelligence
publications.desc: A hybrid RAG and SQL backend for financial PDFs and spreadsheets. Documents are ingested in batch, table cells land in DuckDB, text is embedded in FAISS, and answers come back with citations.

publications.title: WhatsApp CRM
publications.desc: A business messaging platform for campaigns, templates, and conversation follow-up, built to keep client communication in one place.
